titolo: Walter Isaacson on curiosity and creativity in the AI age.
descr: In a new Dialogues on Technology and Society episode, Isaacson argues that human judgment remains vital as AI tools become ubiquitous.
paragrafi: Walter Isaacson sat down with Google senior vice president Kent Walker for a Dialogues on Technology and Society interview released on November 19, 2026.
The conversation highlighted how historic innovators like Leonardo da Vinci, Benjamin Franklin and Ada Lovelace relied on teamwork, curiosity and human judgment to achieve breakthroughs.
Isaacson stresses that, despite AI putting information at our fingertips, the ability to ask the right questions and make nuanced decisions is more important than ever.
The episode appears alongside announcements about new Gemini features, including a lower‑memory Android app and tool retrieval in the Gemini API.
FreeLLMArena’s latest blind vote ranks Kimi K3 (Max) as the top free chat model and Gemini 4 Carbon (High) as the leading paid chat model.
perche: For AI users, the discussion reinforces the need to combine AI assistance with personal curiosity and critical thinking. For those seeking free or locally run models, the current rankings show strong open‑source options that can complement such a collaborative approach.
